reasoning: As of March 2026, I need to assess whether the US had two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth between Q1 2024 and Q4 2025. The US economy showed resilience through 2024 with positive growth. For 2025, while there were recession concerns due to tariff policies and economic uncertainty, the economy generally maintained positive growth through most quarters. The BEA 3rd estimates for all 2025 quarters would be available by now. Given the strong labor market and consumer spending that persisted, a technical recession (two consecutive negative quarters) was unlikely but possible given policy uncertainty.
